meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Maximum-saturation research orchestration: ALWAYS proposes the final materials first (PDF+DOCX default), then parallel explore+librarian swarms across codebase, web, official docs, and OSS repos — max-roster teammode when the harness has it — with live journaling, a recursive EXPAND loop driven by leads workers return in message text, empirical verification by running code, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind a mandatory visual-QA gate. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research — the word 'ulw-research' ('/ulw-research', '$ulw-research'), any 'ulw' research wording, 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发起深度研究，自动产出一份有引证、有图表的综合报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在短时间内获得系统化、可查证的深度研究材料
copy.tagline_en: Run deep research, get a comprehensive, cited report with charts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a systematic, verifiable research report in minutes

howto.what: 收到深度研究请求后,它会启动饱和式调查:先交付默认 PDF+DOCX 的成果样稿,再派多组并行搜索覆盖代码库、网页、官方文档与开源仓库,沿线索反复深挖,用运行代码验证争议说法,最终产出带引用、图表并经质检的报告。
howto.when: 仅当用户明确要求研究时触发:提到“ulw-research”等触发词、要求“ultradebate”式调研、或明确请求做深度调查(不限语言)。普通提问、调试或搜集背景信息不触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 彻查一下 RAG 的评测方法。
say.note: 会启动多组并行搜索,并用运行代码验证争议结论。

say.text: ulw-research 调一下最近五年向量数据库的论文走向。
say.note: 会先给出 PDF+DOCX 样稿,再按线索展开搜索。

howto.what_en: On research requests, Claude runs saturation research: proposes PDF+DOCX first, launches parallel swarms (codebase, web, docs, OSS), expands leads, verifies contested claims by code, and delivers a cited synthesis with charts after QA.
howto.when_en: Activates only on explicit research demand: 'ulw-research', 'ultradebate'/'hyperdebate' requests, or an explicit ask for deep research in any language. Ordinary questions, debugging, or context-gathering never trigger it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to dig into evaluation methods for RAG.
say_en.note: It launches parallel searches and verifies contested claims by running code.

say_en.text: Run an ultradebate: compare MVCC implementations of Postgres vs MySQL.
say_en.note: At least two skeptic perspectives attack each contested claim.

say_en.text: ulw-research: map the research trends of vector databases over the last five years.
say_en.note: It first proposes PDF+DOCX drafts, then expands from worker leads.
